findings.title: Federated recovery-code validation never consumes a code
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator returns true for any matching code without removing it or recording its use. In addition, getCredentials() reconstructs a fresh credential from the complete original list on every call. Consequently, the same recovery code can authenticate repeatedly, the login form always requests the first code, and exhaustion never triggers regeneration. The new integration test only performs one login, so it passes despite this broken one-time-code lifecycle. Consume successful codes in the test provider and test replay rejection, progression to the next code, and exhaustion.
